newsitem.title: USA: Conn. gas tax drops by three cents - report.
newsitem.headline: Conn. gas tax drops by three cents - report.

text.p: Connecticut's gasoline tax will drop three cents Tuesday, but the state continues to have the highest gasoline tax and price in the nation, Hartford Courant reported today.
The gas tax cut to 36 cents per gallon is pegged to the start of the state's new fiscal year Tuesday, and the beginning of the $21 billion two-year budget.
The budget increase will be 2.1 percent in the first year and 1.4 percent in the second year.
More than 60 new laws take effect Tuesday, including many linked to the budget.
Although lawmakers passed a series of other tax cuts, many of them, such as income and property tax credits, are pegged to the calendar year.
